scripts.qd: mise exec rust@stable -- cargo run --quiet --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml --
scripts.qd:build: mise exec rust@stable -- cargo build --release --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml
scripts.qd:build:linux: mise exec rust@stable -- cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml
scripts.qd:build:windows: mise exec rust@stable -- cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml
scripts.qd:build:macos: mise exec rust@stable -- cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml && mise exec rust@stable -- cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml
scripts.desktop:build:web: bun run desktop:css && bun build --compile --target=browser --minify ./src/desktop/index.html --outdir dist
scripts.desktop:dev: bun run desktop:css && bun run tauri -- dev
scripts.desktop:build:macos: bun run tauri -- build --ci --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg && bun run tauri -- build --ci --target x86_64-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg
scripts.desktop:package:linux: bun run desktop:build && bun run qd:build:linux && bun run scripts/package-linux-release.ts
scripts.desktop:install: bun run qd:build && bun run scripts/install-desktop.ts
scripts.desktop:install:local: bun run local:server:up && QUICKDROP_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 bun run desktop:install
scripts.quickdrop:install: bun install && CI=false bun run desktop:build && bun run desktop:install
scripts.quickdrop:install:local: bun install && CI=false bun run desktop:build && bun run desktop:install:local
